required_observables.name: Reported observing windows and approximate projected speed ranges
Official daily azimuthal-mean pB radial scan, 53 samples with angular standard deviation
Calibrated K-Cor/eclipse pB and electron-density arrays with uncertainties
Measured front points and component associations with uncertainties
Published directional electron-density inversion metadata and data availability
Actual calibrated L2 exposure UTC, brightness/polarization, geometry and processing provenance

missing_required_inputs: A reviewed exposure/region/baseline selection and the calibrated local images, masks and error products needed for the actual comparison. The verified17:56:41UTC L2 exposure is later than eclipse totality, is reprocessed in2025 and has no error extension; it is not a verified quiet or simultaneous reference.

Eclipse images or derived pB/electron-density tables with observation location, exact timing, image registration, radiometric calibration, sky/background treatment, line-of-sight inversion assumptions and uncertainty/covariance.
Feature-by-feature measured front positions and uncertainty regions, including an explicit association between the eclipse double-bubble components and the later K-Cor CMEs.
Event-specific magnetogram/PFSS configuration and Sun-observer geometry plus a reviewed projection/Thomson-scattering forward operator.
A shock-versus-material-front identification and geometry model capable of representing the observed components; plane-of-sky speed ranges alone do not establish a 3D shock or spherical closure.
Reviewed observational scoring metrics and uncertainty acceptance; no numerical tolerance is inferred from approximate published ranges.

comparison.acceptance_policy: Preserve existing registered criteria; no new numerical tolerance or fitted forcing is supplied by this metadata package.

frame_units.time: UTC; minute-level caption times are not exact exposure times
frame_units.position: Plane of sky from each declared observing site; no HCI Cartesian reconstruction is supplied
frame_units.speed: km s^-1 plane-of-sky approximate ranges; no deprojection applied
frame_units.brightness: Daily 360-degree azimuthal-mean pB in B/Bsun; second column is angular standard deviation, not measurement-error sigma.
frame_units.density: Electron density requires its actual published inversion and uncertainty; no density values fabricated

acquisition.note: The official date selector and linked numerical engineering table are reachable using curl. The table gives pB and azimuthal standard deviation in B/Bsun at radii1.07–2.11Rsun, without an exposure timestamp in the file. Full calibrated images and derived electron-density arrays are not acquired.
